newsitem.title: USA: IMF views Mexico economic program favorably.
newsitem.headline: IMF views Mexico economic program favorably.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund said Mexico's economic program unveiled on Tuesday was ambitious but achievable, pledging to work with Mexico to make sure the program's objectives were achieved.

"It demonstrates that the Mexican authorities are determined to continue with their efforts to consolidate macroeconomic stability and raise living standards," Claudio Loser, director of the IMF's western hemisphere department, said in a statement.

The emphasis on fiscal consolidation and key structural reforms, particularly the restructuring of the banking system and further deregulation, was indispensable to genarate and mobilize additional domestic savings, Loser said.
